Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.action

Enum Class ActionInterface.Type

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<ActionInterface.Type>
io.github.jspinak.brobot.action.ActionInterface.Type
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<ActionInterface.Type>, Constable
Enclosing interface:
ActionInterface
public static enum ActionInterface.Type extends Enum<ActionInterface.Type>
Defines the standard types of GUI automation actions available in the framework. This enum serves as an internal identifier for logging and dispatching.

Actions are divided into two categories:

  • Basic Actions: Atomic operations that directly interact with the GUI
  • Composite Actions: Complex operations that combine multiple basic actions

Basic Actions:

  • FIND - Searches for visual patterns on screen
  • CLICK - Performs mouse click operations
  • DEFINE - Captures a screen region with specific coordinates
  • TYPE - Sends keyboard input to the active window
  • MOVE - Moves the mouse cursor to a location
  • VANISH - Waits for elements to disappear from screen
  • HIGHLIGHT - Draws visual indicators on matches or regions
  • SCROLL_MOUSE_WHEEL - Performs mouse wheel scrolling
  • MOUSE_DOWN - Presses and holds mouse button
  • MOUSE_UP - Releases mouse button
  • KEY_DOWN - Presses and holds keyboard key
  • KEY_UP - Releases keyboard key
  • CLASSIFY - Performs color-based classification

Composite Actions:

  • CLICK_UNTIL - Repeatedly clicks until a condition is met
  • DRAG - Performs click-and-drag operations
